newsitem.title: USA: AVIC Group names 3 directors, expands board.
newsitem.headline: AVIC Group names 3 directors, expands board.

text.p: AVIC Group International Inc said Monday three new directors have been appointed to the board.

Joining the AVIC board are Drew Lewis, former U.S. Secretary of Transportation and recently retired chairman of Union Pacific Corp, Klaus Schwab, founder and president of the World Economic Forum, Geneva, and Michael H. Wilson, vice chairman of RBC Dominion Securities Inc of Canada.
The company said that Michael Lim, chief financial officer, is retiring as an inside board member. All changes are effective as of May 1.
Chairman Joseph R. Wright said he expects to name a fourth new member soon, expanding the board to nine members.
